svg.aria-label: How the check works. Your request, such as writing a parser for Xcode's project.xcproj files, goes to your agent, which inverts it into what the plan assumes doesn't exist and writes two queries. sota-anchor searches the last year of arXiv, Hugging Face, GitHub, npm and crates.io and returns dated evidence. Your agent judges the evidence, never its memory, and reaches one of three outcomes: reuse what exists, build it because nothing better exists, or no verdict because nothing was found.
